About TraceSeis

A Houston-based geoscience company specializing in quantitative reservoir characterization since 2003.

Our Company

TraceSeis is a privately owned company founded in 2003 in Houston, Texas. The company provides specialized geoscience solutions through services, consulting, and software, with expertise in characterizing relationships between rock properties, reservoir attributes, and seismic data.

TraceSeis helps clients in the oil and gas industry reduce risk when quantifying reservoir properties using well-calibrated seismic analysis. The company delivers three integrated offerings: specialized geophysical and geological analysis services, expert consulting, and proprietary software solutions.
